projects.title: iPhone Sales Analytics & Business Intelligence Dashboard
projects.overview: Analysed 100+ iPhone sales transactions across models, storage configurations, payment methods and global markets to surface revenue drivers and purchasing behaviour.
projects.deliverable: Two-page interactive Power BI dashboard with custom DAX KPIs, monthly sales trends, customer-segment insights and filters.
projects.pipeline:
1 · Cleaning & EDA: Missing values, duplicates, correlation analysis and outlier detection in Python (Pandas, NumPy).
2 · SQL analysis: MySQL queries on sales trends, region-wise revenue, storage-variant performance and order-level metrics.
3 · Dashboard: Custom DAX measures for dynamic KPIs with interactive filtering.
projects.query:
SELECT storage_variant, COUNT(order_id) AS orders, SUM(sales_amount) AS revenue
FROM iphone_sales
GROUP BY storage_variant
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
projects.queryNote: Illustrative query style used in this project.

projects.title: AI-Driven Job Layoff & Automation Risk Analysis
projects.overview: Two-page interactive Power BI dashboard analysing 20,000 workforce records across AI adoption, task automation, industries, job roles, education and seniority.
projects.deliverable: Interactive workforce risk dashboard with high-risk rates, AI adoption analysis and experience segmentation.
projects.pipeline: Power Query was used to prepare the data and create routine-task exposure and experience bands. DAX measures support executive KPIs and interactive filters.
projects.query: High Risk Rate = DIVIDE( [High-Risk Records], [Total Records], 0 )
projects.queryNote: Measures built: Total Records, High-Risk Records, High-Risk Rate, Avg Task Automation, AI Usage and AI Training Hours.
